accounts: Each strategy and cost: continuous, eight independent calendar-year accounts (2026 ends September), three independent era accounts. Never splice reset accounts. Continuous attribution also reported by era and year.

implementation_conventions.returns: r_N = close[D]/close[D-N]-1; relative strength is arithmetic return difference, not ratio
implementation_conventions.high: Maximum daily HIGH including D in the stated trailing window
implementation_conventions.sma: Arithmetic mean of completed daily CLOSE including each SMA date
implementation_conventions.atr: Arithmetic mean of last14 true ranges, not Wilder smoothing; initial stop = signal close -2.5 ATR
implementation_conventions.below_history: 28 observations D-34 through D-7, excluding latest seven D-6 through D; each below its own causal SMA50
implementation_conventions.cross: Previous close strictly below previous SMA50 and current close strictly above current SMA50, on at least one of D-6 through D
implementation_conventions.tr_contraction: Mean TR D-9..D divided by mean TR D-39..D-10; zero denominator fails
implementation_conventions.holding_age: At signal observation (D+1 00:00 UTC) minus actual entry open; inherited convention
implementation_conventions.context: BTC gate uses D completed close; A week is completed Sunday. No extra inherited v1 weekly/monthly-return entry filter is added to either challenger.
implementation_conventions.no_adds: New entries allow the broker BUY path; all held targets have allow_add=false. Inherited risk/weight trims, stops, partial exits and stale-plan protection retained.
implementation_conventions.delays: D close observed D+1; entries, planned exits and tightened stops become eligible D+2 open. Existing stops and 3R partial profit operate every daily bar, stop first.
implementation_conventions.capacity: Held valid positions first, then fixed-ranked new candidates; no replacement with tomorrow's information
implementation_conventions.idle_cash: Zero interest, no borrowing or leverage; cash included in all returns and exposure denominators
implementation_conventions.missing_market: First missing held daily candle: zero recovery at close, no hindsight terminal-price exit. Shortened and zero-volume source candles retained and audited.
implementation_conventions.history: 240 consecutive daily observations with known LUNA identity boundary reset. Historical archive availability, not present exchangeInfo, defines membership. Full official listing and migration history remains uncertified.
implementation_conventions.krw: Scale USDT net returns to 20m KRW at constant FX, before tax. Show fixed-20m month return PnL, original-account compounding PnL and realized PnL separately; no withdrawals assumed. This is not measured FX-adjusted cash income.

controls.sampling: At each original strategy signal date, K is the count of price-rule qualifiers in the whole historical top80 before holdings/capacity. Draw min(K,N) without replacement from that day's same top80 with BTC gate and 3%..18% initial-stop feasibility. Existing holdings may be drawn; no replacement, no adds. Rank drawn symbols with fresh deterministic random numbers. Same strategy-specific exit, trailing, delay, cost, halt and risk policies.
controls.rng: Python random.Random(f'{strategy}:{seed}:{signal_day_ms}'); sorted eligible symbols; sample then random ranking
controls.statistic: Arithmetic mean of full-calendar-month net returns of the continuous stress account, including idle months
controls.percentile: Number of 200 controls strictly below challenger statistic divided by 200; ties count against challenger; require >=0.975
controls.diagnostic_p: (1 + controls with statistic >= challenger)/(201), reported as Monte Carlo comparison only
controls.retain: Keep seed, performance, monthly path, independent ledger checks and artifact digest; individual ledgers outside Git. Do all controls even when other gates already fail.

uncertainty.method: 4000 circular moving-block resamples of full-month net returns, block length3 months, seed20261025; percentile 2.5% and97.5% endpoints
uncertainty.gate: Lower endpoint of historical 95% interval for arithmetic mean monthly net return must exceed0

decision.gates: Apply every edge_gates_before_forward_paper and capital_growth_relevance_gates value in the unchanged source spec to stress results
decision.positive_calendar_fold_fraction: Positive net-return independent calendar accounts divided by8, including partial2026; threshold0.60 requires at least5/8
decision.challenge_count: Closed campaigns in the independent 2025-01-01..2026-10-01 challenge account
decision.mdd: Continuous stress daily-close MDD plus independent-fold MDD reported. Gate checks continuous AND each reset account, with no permanent halt in any account. Intraday simultaneous-low bound separately reported; trigger is not a guaranteed cap.
decision.PASS: All gates pass and all required audits/controls completed; only eligible for a separate at-least90-day new forward-paper interval
decision.REJECT: Any measured profitability, stability, capital-growth or drawdown/halt gate fails; preserve failed parameters
decision.NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: No measured failure but samples insufficient, or mandatory audit/data/control evidence incomplete; never PASS an unverified run
decision.selection: At most one. If both PASS, higher stress mean full-month net return; ties choose lower MDD magnitude then strategy name. Otherwise select none or the sole PASS.

future_prefix_test: Physically delete every bar on/after2023-01-01; compare all earlier equity, fills, writeoffs and plans for all four continuous accounts, with no terminal liquidation on truncated run
independent_reproduction: Separate validator process reconstructs daily cash/inventory/campaigns, source market eligibility and candidate rules, then reruns all four continuous accounts from new panel objects. Same-author code validation is not an external investment audit.
